blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos Jr. on Tuesday praised the various agencies, volunteers, and hospitality workers behind the successful hosting of the 49th Asean Summit. Marking the handover of the Asean chairship to Singapore on November 17, Marcos thanked the vital organizations and teams whose hard work ensured the event’s success in a social media statement. “My congratulations to all for our successful hosting of the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits. This was the product of the hard work and dedication of a multitude of people and agencies, each of whom played an important role in making this Summit a […]...
